title: A rare match is not a posterior
hook: Two stated cases: explore the prior odds behind a match likelihood.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the prior odds behind a match likelihood affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the prior odds behind a match likelihood in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
